lt.line: O jiems pasakė: „Jei kurio iš jūsų sūnus ar galvijas įkris į šulinį, argi tučtuojau neištrauks jų šeštadienį?!“ Ir jie nesugebėjo į tai atsakyti.

en.event: Friday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: Then he said to them “Who among you, if your son or ox falls into a cistern, would not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?” But they were unable to answer his question.
